description: Office of the Public Service Commission - 5 th Amendment to Printing Service Minute of the Department of Government Printing
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the Printing Service Minute of the Department of Government Printing, specifically detailing recruitment qualifications and procedures for various positions (Offset Litho Print Operator, Letter Press Machine Operator) within the government printing service. The content focuses on public service recruitment criteria, examination requirements, and service conditions, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than government structure/personnel changes or other specialized categories.
